subject: Pilot onboarding and PO-exception request — Solstice Labs
thread_summary: External request from Solstice Labs to onboard for a 3-month pilot without a PO. Procurement proposes a time-limited invoice-only exception with evidence requirements; parties agree to a 90-day exception pending delivery of W-9, insurance, and signed SOW.
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@solsticelabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding + PO question for Solstice Labs

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about the fit. We have a small, time-boxed pilot we
would like to kick off next month (3 months, estimate ~USD 18k total). Our legal team is ready to sign
the SOW; I attached the draft for reference (Solstice-SOW-draft.pdf).

Quick question on procurement: our standard process can be slow — would Redwood consider a short
invoice-only path (no PO) to start the pilot while we finish internal PO routing? We can provide W-9,
proof of insurance, and the signed SOW immediately. If needed, we can agree to a condensed approval
term (90 days) with a review before extension.

If that's feasible, what specific evidence do you need and who should we send it to?

Appreciate the help — want to keep momentum.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Head of Partnerships | Solstice Labs
attachments: Solstice-SOW-draft.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@solsticelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:01:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding + PO question for Solstice Labs

Aisha — thanks for the context and the draft SOW.

On Mon, Apr 19, 2027 at 09:23 Aisha Patel <aisha@solsticelabs.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about the fit. We have a small, time-boxed pilot...

Looping in Procurement (Naomi) and Finance (Grace) to confirm the evidence we need and what a
short-term exception looks like on our side. Our standard rule is "PO required" for vendor onboarding,
but we do offer temporary invoice-only exceptions for pilots under a certain threshold with a limited
duration and documented evidence.

A few quick asks to speed the decision:
- Confirm expected spend and billing cadence (you noted ~$18k over 3 months — is that invoice
  monthly or single invoice at the end?)
- Does Solstice handle any customer data that would require a security questionnaire?
- Preferred billing/legal contact for DocuSign and W-9/insurance docs.

We can provisionally agree to evaluate a 90-day invoice-only exception if Procurement gets the
required evidence. Naomi — can you advise the checklist and approval path?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: internal-guidance-excerpt.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:15:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding + PO question for Solstice Labs

Karthik / Marissa — thanks for the flag.

We can support a time-limited invoice-only onboarding for pilot customers that meet our exception
criteria. Below is what Procurement will need to approve a 90-day exception: 

Required (upload to vendor portal):
- Executed SOW (signed by Solstice + Redwood) — PDF
- W-9 or equivalent tax form for US entities
- Proof of liability insurance (certificate of insurance)
- Vendor contact + remittance info (bank wiring / billing email)

Conditional (if you handle customer data / model inputs):
- Completed security questionnaire (or SOC-2 report if available)

Controls and terms we will apply:
- Exception duration: 90 days from the invoice date; extension requires a follow-up review
- Spend cap for exception: USD 25,000 total (pilots above that must have a PO before provisioning)
- Payments team will hold remittance pending evidence submission; we will not block the pilot but
  will require evidence within 7 business days of the first invoice

Attached is the evidence checklist template (evidence-checklist.xlsx). I'll start the approval
routing once we receive the documents. If Solstice agrees, please sign our temporary-exception form
via the DocuSign link below.

DocuSign (temporary exception form): https://www.docusign.com/temporary-exception/SOL-4821

Naomi Feldman
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: evidence-checklist.xlsx

From: Aisha Patel <aisha@solsticelabs.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, legal@solsticelabs.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 16:04:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding + PO question for Solstice Labs

Naomi / Karthik — great, that works for us. Quick answers: 
- Budget: USD 18,000 total; invoiced monthly (3 invoices of USD 6,000 each)
- Data: pilot will process non-sensitive telemetry only; no customer PII or protected data
- Billing contact: accounts@solsticelabs.com

We uploaded the requested materials to the DocuSign package and vendor portal and signed the
temporary-exception form. Attached is the signed SOW for your records (Solstice-Signed-SOW.pdf).

On the exception duration, 90 days is fine — we will request a check-in at day 60 to align on usage
and extension terms. Please confirm when Procurement marks the exception approved so Finance
can accept the first invoice.

Thanks for helping speed this up — looking forward to starting.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Head of Partnerships | Solstice Labs
attachments: Solstice-Signed-SOW.pdf
